_comment: The repo gates itself. Every id listed here gets the freshness check when you pass --artifact-map; an id with no entry prints a NOTICE saying so. Keep this list equal to what the reviewer actually read. A card's OWN file (.tasks/<id>.md) is NOT a judged artifact and must not be listed for that id: its Status/progress fields change as part of normal lifecycle closing (IN_REVIEW -> CLOSED), which would make the round's own verdict stale the moment the card is closed, and no later round revisits a closed card to supersede it. List the code, docs and evidence the reviewer read, not the card that records the review. See EVO-20261010-001. EVO verdicts are deliberately NOT listed here (rule, P2-4 of EVO-20261020-001, 2026-10-20): an EVO verdict is produced in the reviewer's own workspace, so the FF merge that lands it refreshes this tree's mtimes after the verdict's ts -- measured: registering one made its own four artifacts STALE (gate 124 -> 128) -- and re-signing its ts would forge the review timeline. Claim surfaces an EVO round touched are covered by the next task-card round that lists them with a PASS; UNMAPPED_CLAIM_SURFACE warnings in between are transient by design.
